notes: Wraps the test body in a loop of three attempts that catches Throwable and only prints a message. If all three attempts fail the test still passes, so the failure is swallowed, not only retried. Only the test file of a large commit is kept. It also reports weaken_assertion/assertion_removed under ADR 0007 Decision 5: the assertions of doCurrentTimeMicros, which the test reaches through the method reference this::doCurrentTimeMicros and which belong to its before set, are now reached only from a call newly placed under a loop and under a try whose catch does not rethrow.
